paths.name: Wipe Out
paths.after: Clean field. Their remaining Grunts can be recruited; their Boss is yours to recruit, exile or let go.

paths.name: Shadow
paths.fantasy: Rule from behind a clean face
paths.after: The region thinks it's free. Low upkeep, high income; if Wanted ever passes 60 here, the Shadow cracks.

paths.name: Monarch
paths.after: The region bows. High tribute, Gym Leaders serve you; Legendaries and rebels keep coming.

paths.name: Goal
paths.fantasy: Achieve what you set out to do

bonus.name: Foundations
bonus.text: your Rock and Ground Pokémon take −20% damage; crew Hardiness training ×1.5.

holdings.catch: Brock is a gentle Leader: Buy and Convert easy, Break gives Dread penalty.
holdings.note: Rock and Ground crew taking −20% damage waits for a battle hook; Hardiness training is Brawn training.

bonus.name: Water Show
bonus.text: a free weekly Water-type Pokémon gift from the pool; fishing hauls +25%.

holdings.catch: Misty's sisters hold the pool; Blackmail needs 3 Scouts.
holdings.note: Fishing hauls +25% wait for fishing.

bonus.name: Hard Wire
bonus.text: Electric crew are +1 Speed stage; the lock puzzle opens every locked door in the city for you.

holdings.catch: Break means going through the trash-can lock puzzle.
holdings.note: Electric crew +1 Speed waits for a battle hook; the lock puzzle opening doors is +5% on jobs in Vermilion.

bonus.name: Perfume
bonus.text: Grass crew heal 10% each night; Charm actions +15% odds.

holdings.catch: Erika is in a kimono shop; Break is a long fight (a garden maze).
holdings.note: Grass crew heal each night: every crew Pokémon heals each week.

bonus.name: Ninja Lessons
bonus.text: Poison crew gain Stealth; one crew member each week becomes "unseen" (Heat −5).

holdings.catch: Koga's invisible-wall maze; Blackmail impossible (Koga has no secrets).

bonus.name: Foresight
bonus.text: you see the next Rival or Hero move one day ahead; Psychic crew +10% crit.

holdings.catch: Sabrina uses the Debate against you; Convert needs Wits.
holdings.note: Psychic crew +10% crit waits for a battle hook.

bonus.name: Hot Quiz
bonus.text: Fire crew +15% damage; a weekly quiz that grants one free item.

holdings.catch: Blaine's quiz: a wrong answer costs a crew Pokémon HP.
holdings.note: Fire crew +15% damage waits for a battle hook; the quiz is one free item a week (a Lucky Egg: the game has no Rare Candy).

bonus.name: Boss Seat
bonus.text: the rival evil team's HQ is this Gym. Taking it ends the "Wipe Out" path and removes their seat; Ground crew +20% damage.

holdings.catch: Only after the rival team is Cornered.
holdings.note: Ground crew +20% damage waits for a battle hook.

bonus.name: Hall of Fame
bonus.text: an Elite Four slot you can fill with your own crew; one free Champion-level battle practice a week.

holdings.catch: Needs 8 Gyms; E4 each fought in a row.
holdings.note: Filling an Elite Four seat with your crew waits for D15 (holders).

bonus.name: Summit
bonus.text: Red appears if you hold it, and the Hero's ceiling is capped one stage lower.

holdings.catch: Unlocked only after the Champion.
holdings.note: Red appearing waits for D15.

bonus.name: Quiet Beginnings
bonus.text: the first crew member you recruit each week is guaranteed one rank above average.

holdings.catch: A tiny town; every Holding in it counts.

bonus.name: Gateway
bonus.text: every Kanto route trainer's bounty on your crew drops 20%; the Trainer House gives one free practice battle a day.

holdings.catch: Giovanni's Gym sits in the middle of town, so the city only counts as Annexed once the Gym is taken or the rival team is Cornered.
holdings.note: The Trainer House practice battle waits for D15.

bonus.name: Stone Quarry
bonus.text: Rock-type Pokémon in the shop; construction costs −10%.

holdings.catch: Museum and Gym both help.
holdings.note: Construction −10% is paid back as ₽700 a week; Rock-type Pokémon "in the shop" come to the Reserve every two weeks.

bonus.name: Bridge Control
bonus.text: a toll on Nugget Bridge (+₽300/day).

holdings.catch: The Rocket-recruit trainer on the Bridge fights you.

bonus.name: Harbour
bonus.text: access to SS Anne and fast expansion plus import/export lines (smuggling routes +2).

holdings.catch: The port is also the Navy's.
holdings.note: SS Anne access and +2 smuggling routes wait for D15 (routes per region): paid as harbour fees.

bonus.name: Quiet Town
bonus.text: police never patrol; Ghost crew +10% evasion.

holdings.catch: Pokémon Tower is a Landmark of its own.
holdings.note: Ghost crew +10% evasion waits for a battle hook.

bonus.name: Department Store Empire
bonus.text: shop income ×2; the largest ₽ city in Kanto.

holdings.catch: Game Corner and Dept Store both belong to Team Rocket's front.

bonus.name: Silph Capital
bonus.text: Silph Co., the Gym and the Dojo in one city; every Holding in Kanto pays +5% of its income to you as "corporate cut".

holdings.catch: Needs Silph Co. first, and Sabrina's Gym next; police stay out of Silph's streets only while you hold both.

bonus.name: Safari Gate
bonus.text: the Safari Zone's daily wild haul feeds your Pens.

holdings.catch: The Warden's house is a quest.

bonus.name: Volcano Island
bonus.text: Fire-type Pokémon in the shop; the Lab's research.

holdings.catch: Needs a Key from Blaine.
holdings.note: The Lab's research is the Cinnabar Lab's own Holding.

bonus.name: Pokédex Wing
bonus.text: every species you catch is recorded; you can see wild Pokémon's levels on every route; starter selection for new recruits (their first Pokémon is a free starter). Prof. Oak becomes a "visitor", never a recruit.

holdings.catch: Prof. Oak is a canon adult but beloved: Heat +30 if you force it; Infiltrate preferred.
holdings.note: Seeing wild levels and free starters for recruits wait for D15.

bonus.name: Mom's Cooking
bonus.text: crew are fully healed and their Loyalty +2 each week.

holdings.catch: A home; no Heat, but a smear if you rob it.

bonus.name: Rival's Study
bonus.text: the Hero's Threat is shown 2 steps ahead.

holdings.catch: Daisy owns it; Buy only.

bonus.name: Trainer School
bonus.text: walk-in recruits +1 a week (adults only).

holdings.catch: Staff are adults; minors never.

bonus.name: Fossil Hall
bonus.text: a free fossil revive a month.

holdings.catch: Amber and fossils are protected by the guard trainer.
holdings.note: The monthly fossil comes back to life at once and joins the Reserve.

bonus.name: Moon Stone Cache
bonus.text: a Moon Stone each week; Clefairy fairs at night.

holdings.catch: A rival squad camps here.

bonus.name: Storage Cloud
bonus.text: your Pokémon Storage holds +100.

holdings.catch: Bill is a hermit; Buy or Convert.
holdings.note: Storage +100 waits for D15: Bill's help is +5% on jobs in Cerulean.

holdings.catch: The five trainers on the bridge attack.

bonus.name: Cruise Ship
bonus.text: a floating HQ room set; Cruise events (high-roller recruits).

holdings.catch: Only while docked; Captain's permission.
holdings.note: A floating HQ room set waits for D15.

bonus.name: Fan Club
bonus.text: Regard +10 at once and +2 weekly; any Pikachu or Raichu in your crew gains +2 Loyalty a week.

holdings.catch: The Chairman talks for a full day: a Buy-out starts with a Debate you must sit through (one lost action).
holdings.note: Pikachu and Raichu Loyalty: every member +1 Loyalty a week.

bonus.name: Tunnel
bonus.text: a hidden route from Vermilion to Pewter; −1 travel day.

holdings.catch: A rival squad uses it.
holdings.note: Fast travel waits for a Dominion map: the shortcut is +5% on jobs in Vermilion.

bonus.name: Dark Passage
bonus.text: Flash-free route; Ghost crew +1.

holdings.catch: Needs light; a trainer gate.
holdings.note: Ghost crew +1 waits for a battle hook: a lit tunnel is +5% on jobs in Lavender.

bonus.name: Memorial
bonus.text: Ghost crew +20% evasion; the "Mr. Fuji" rescue event repeats.

holdings.catch: Ghosts attack until the Silph Scope.
holdings.note: Ghost crew +20% evasion and the Mr. Fuji event wait for D15.

bonus.name: Kanto Broadcast
bonus.text: Morning Report news + ; Dread/Regard +15 a week.

holdings.catch: Needs a Card and the Power Plant's electricity.
holdings.note: Morning Report news from the Tower is D25's paper.

bonus.name: Underground HQ
bonus.text: a free 6-slot hideout under the Game Corner, with a spin-tile maze that stops any raider who doesn't know the route.

holdings.catch: Rocket grunts hold every floor, and you need the Lift Key from a Rocket Scientist's fight to reach the deepest room.
holdings.note: Six guard posts wait for HQ defence: the hidden base cools Celadon and adds Dread each week.

bonus.name: Big Laundering
bonus.text: 5% laundering; prize Pokémon (Porygon, Abra).

holdings.catch: The hidden switch under the poster.

bonus.name: One-Stop Shop
bonus.text: all shop items −15%; vending machine buffs (Fresh Water etc.).

holdings.catch: The roof rooftop kids; adult staff only.
holdings.note: Shop prices −15% wait for a Dominion shop.

bonus.name: Dev Room
bonus.text: Game Freak–style secrets; Eevee gift once.

holdings.catch: The Eevee gift is a one-time event.
holdings.note: The Dev Room's secrets are the one Eevee.

bonus.name: Day Care
bonus.text: breeding +1 egg; stolen Pokémon raised faster.

holdings.catch: The old couple; never forced (Regard).
holdings.note: Raising stolen Pokémon faster waits for D15: the extra egg hatches every two weeks.

bonus.name: Master Ball Research
bonus.text: one Master Ball per region, tech parts +50%, a free Garage, and Silph's Card Key opens every door in Saffron.

holdings.catch: Eleven floors held by Rocket in Giovanni's takeover; each floor is a battle, and the President is a hostage you must free, not hurt.
holdings.note: Tech parts +50% and the free Garage wait for D15; the Card Key is +10% on jobs in Saffron.

bonus.name: Dojo
bonus.text: Fighting crew train at ×2; the Karate Master joins as a trainer (adult).

holdings.catch: The Dojo's master only joins after a duel.

bonus.name: Copycat
bonus.text: one free duplicate of any item you hold, once a week.

holdings.catch: Copycat is temperamental: she only trades after a mimic mini-game (Wits roll), and a miss costs a day.
holdings.note: Duplicating any held item waits for D15: she copies an Ether each week.

bonus.name: Wild Reserve
bonus.text: five wild Pokémon for your Pokémon reserve each day; rare species chance +10%.

holdings.catch: The Warden's quest first; guards.
holdings.note: Five a day would swamp the Reserve: two a week, rare chance kept in the pool.

bonus.name: Warden's Teeth
bonus.text: the Gold Teeth event; HM rewards.

holdings.catch: A pawn: the Warden is a long-term quest.
holdings.note: The Gold Teeth event is the Warden's ₽3,000 thank-you; HM rewards wait for field moves in Dominion.

bonus.name: Free Electricity
bonus.text: all HQ machine rooms −30% upkeep.

holdings.catch: Zapdos rumours; a Legendary guards it.
holdings.note: Free power plays as −30% on the Holdings' weekly upkeep.

bonus.name: Fossil Revive
bonus.text: revive Helix, Dome and Old Amber fossils; Mewtwo rumour starts; one rare research reward per month.

holdings.catch: A scientist group guards it, and the Lab becomes a target for Team Rocket once Mewtwo rumours begin.
holdings.note: The Mewtwo rumour waits for D15.

bonus.name: Ruins
bonus.text: Secret Key, and diary pages unlock the full Mewtwo track; Fire crew +5% in the ruins.

holdings.catch: Burned-out traps and trainers; you need Blaine's Gym first because he owns the Mansion's key.
holdings.note: The Secret Key opens Blaine's Gym, already yours; the diary's Mewtwo track waits for D15.

bonus.name: Ice Cave
bonus.text: the Articuno rumour track opens; Water/Ice crew +10% damage; a boulder puzzle gives a free shortcut to Cinnabar.

holdings.catch: You need Strength to move the boulders, and Articuno guards the deepest room.
holdings.note: The Articuno rumour, sea travel and Water/Ice +10% wait for D15: the islands are +5% on jobs in Fuchsia.

bonus.name: Unknown Dungeon
bonus.text: high-level wild Pokémon every week; a Mewtwo rite; Ultra Ball cache.

holdings.catch: Locked until the League is beaten; every floor is a Veteran-level battle.
holdings.note: The Mewtwo rite waits for D15.

bonus.name: Toll to the League
bonus.text: all League challengers pay you ₽500.

holdings.catch: Strength puzzles; rival team patrols.

bonus.name: Bike Gang
bonus.text: your crew rides free bikes (travel −1 day); a biker gang recruits (adults only).

holdings.catch: Rival biker gangs ambush at night; a gang leader fight is needed to open the toll.
holdings.note: Fast travel waits for a Dominion map: the road is +5% on jobs in Celadon.

bonus.name: Gliding Lessons
bonus.text: Flying crew +1 Speed stage; spot enemy squads by air.

holdings.catch: Falkner is a young Leader; Beat only if `minor` flagged.

bonus.name: Hive Lab
bonus.text: Bug crew +15% damage; Apricorn fruit income (+₽150/day).

holdings.catch: Bugsy is a kid; adult-run Gym assistants only.

bonus.name: Miltank Rolls
bonus.text: Normal crew HP +10%; Whitney's tears event gives Regard.

holdings.catch: Whitney is a minor: Beat only.

bonus.name: Ghost Dance
bonus.text: Ghost crew +20% evasion; the "Kimono Girls" dance event unlocks.

holdings.catch: Morty is a ghost-sage; Blackmail impossible.

bonus.name: Dojo Waterfall
bonus.text: Fighting crew train ×2 (one tier higher).

holdings.catch: Chuck is stubborn: Beat first.

bonus.name: Lighthouse Link
bonus.text: Steel crew +10% defense; the Lighthouse's Ampharos.

holdings.catch: Jasmine is a minor-adjacent trainer: Beat only.

bonus.name: Ice Sculptures
bonus.text: Ice crew +15% damage; a stream of ₽ from tourists.

holdings.catch: Pryce is an old man; Convert easy.

bonus.name: Dragon's Den
bonus.text: Dragon-type Pokémon in the shop; the Dragon Master rank.

holdings.catch: Clair demands you beat her team first.

bonus.name: Johto Hall of Fame
bonus.text: the same League seat as in Kanto (shared, not doubled); Johto's Champion Lance becomes a training partner.

holdings.catch: Needs 8 Johto badges; the Elite Four and Lance are fought in a row.

bonus.name: Lab Town
bonus.text: one free Pokémon egg a month.

holdings.catch: Prof. Elm's Lab is here.

bonus.name: Egg Lab
bonus.text: hatch eggs ×2; research on Mystery Egg.

holdings.catch: Elm is a kind professor; Infiltrate preferred.

bonus.name: Seaside Stop
bonus.text: a free Potion each night and a Pokédex gift to every new recruit (a map and a rough route list).

holdings.catch: A tiny town; the old man with the Map Card must be treated kindly or Regard −10.

bonus.name: Sprout Tower
bonus.text: Bellsprout fans (Grass +1).

holdings.catch: The Sprout Tower elders block.

bonus.name: Sage Training
bonus.text: crew gain Wits +1 each week; Falkner's mentor teaches a Flying move once.

holdings.catch: The Sages never fight; a Buy-out needs a Debate on discipline, and force makes Regard −20.

bonus.name: Apricorn Shop
bonus.text: Kurt's Apricorn Balls in your shop (Level, Fast, Friend Balls); Heavy Ball for heavy species; Apricorn income +₽150/day.

holdings.catch: Kurt is an old craftsman; he only sells to someone who finishes his Apricorn order.

bonus.name: Slowpoke Tails
bonus.text: +₽400/day selling tails; a hidden path to the Rocket-hidden cache.

holdings.catch: Team Rocket guards it; the owners will not sell, so only a Raid works and Regard −10.

bonus.name: Metropolis
bonus.text: all income ×1.5; Magnet Train link.

holdings.catch: Radio Tower, Dept Store and Game Corner.

bonus.name: Sunday Sale
bonus.text: all items −20% on weekends.

holdings.catch: Dept Store staff are adults.

bonus.name: Laundering
bonus.text: 5% laundering; Abra and Ekans prize Pokémon; coin cases give crew free tokens.

holdings.catch: Police patrol at night; a raid by the Goldenrod Police ends in Heat +15.

bonus.name: Johto Broadcast
bonus.text: Morning Report news +; Spread the Word free weekly; Regard/Dread +30.

holdings.catch: Team Rocket's takeover; needs the Radio Card.

bonus.name: Basement Bargains
bonus.text: a barber (crew grooming Loyalty +1) and dealers selling contraband; +₽250/day in weekend sales.

holdings.catch: Rocket's early hideout still has switches; a Rocket tail follows if you ignore it.

bonus.name: Rail Link
bonus.text: fast travel between any held Johto and Kanto cities (−2 travel days); import/export routes +1.

holdings.catch: The Power Plant in Kanto must be restored first; engineers demand a fair deal.

bonus.name: Bug-Catching Contest
bonus.text: a monthly contest gives ₽2,000 and a rare bug; Regard +10 once.

holdings.catch: The Park Ranger is strict: a Buy-out is a Debate on conservation (Nerve roll).

bonus.name: Dance Theater
bonus.text: a stage for Kimono Girls (adult); Ghost +.

holdings.catch: Burned Tower is a Landmark.

bonus.name: Legendary Beasts' Den
bonus.text: Raikou, Entei and Suicune rumour track opens; Fire crew +10%; ghost trainers.

holdings.catch: The Beasts flee unless you carry the Clear Bell; unburned planks collapse under crew (HP loss).

bonus.name: Rainbow Wing Site
bonus.text: the Ho-Oh rumour track opens; Regard +20 once; Rainbow Wing weekly clue.

holdings.catch: You need a Rainbow Wing from the Tin Tower first; the old Sage watches.

bonus.name: Unown Archive
bonus.text: research; crew Wits +1; Psychic crew +10%.

holdings.catch: Scientists are protective; Infiltrate needs three Scouts or a Debate on ethics.

bonus.name: Port Lights
bonus.text: sea control (ships +1); a Pokémon Center and Glitter Lighthouse view.

holdings.catch: The Lighthouse is its own Holding; sailors only sell if the city feels safe.

bonus.name: Beacon
bonus.text: ships bow to you (sea smuggling +1); Amphy and Steelix events; Jasmine's cure story.

holdings.catch: Jasmine's illness quest first (Secret Potion); a lighthouse keeper only hands the key after that.

bonus.name: Pharmacy
bonus.text: Revive supply (+2 Revives a week); Storm Drum event.

holdings.catch: A pharmacist owner; an extortion makes him close shop, so Buy only.

bonus.name: Hideout Town
bonus.text: a Rocket base under the Souvenir Shop (free 4-slot hideout); a Rocket Boss rumour.

holdings.catch: The shop's secret switch needs a Scout; Rocket grunts defend it in a long battle.

bonus.name: Gyarados Lake
bonus.text: a weekly red Gyarados event (a shiny Magikarp roll); fishing +50%.

holdings.catch: The Radio Tower signal makes Gyarados furious; wild Gyarados attack crew.

bonus.name: Dragon's Den Gate
bonus.text: Dragon-type rites; Move Deleter and Move Reminder shops; Dragon crew +5%.

holdings.catch: Clair's Gym first; the Move Deleter only accepts those who have fought Clair.

bonus.name: Dragon Shrine
bonus.text: Dragon crew +10%; a Dratini egg monthly; Dragon Scale trade.

holdings.catch: Clair's trial of knowledge must be passed; wild Dragons attack at night.

bonus.name: Lugia's Nest
bonus.text: the Lugia rumour track opens; Water crew +10%; tidal caves hide treasure.

holdings.catch: Needs Whirlpool and Waterfall; Lugia guards the deepest room.

bonus.name: Ho-Oh Peak
bonus.text: the sacred stair opens the Ho-Oh track; Regard +20; a Rainbow Wing is awarded once.

holdings.catch: Needs the Beasts awakened and the Clear Bell; Sage guards the top.

bonus.name: Wild Reserve
bonus.text: five wild Pokémon a day; Safari species (Larvitar, Houndour); rare chance +10%.

holdings.catch: The Pokémon ranch is private; a Debate with the owner is needed, then guards patrol.

bonus.name: Celebi Shrine
bonus.text: Celebi rumour track opens; Grass crew +10%; Farfetch'd herding event.

holdings.catch: You need a GS Ball, and the shrine keeper only opens it for a respectful visitor.

bonus.name: Black Market Cave
bonus.text: a contraband dealer (+₽300/day); hidden TMs.

holdings.catch: Rocket's tunnel connects here; you need Flash or crew with torches.

bonus.name: Union Pass
bonus.text: Rock/Ground crew +10%; Lapras event on Fridays.

holdings.catch: A cave full of hiker trainers; a collapse can strand crew for a day.

bonus.name: Waterfall Dojo
bonus.text: Tyrogue event; Fighting crew train ×1.5; a free Black Belt practice weekly.

holdings.catch: A dojo guards the waterfalls; a Debate with the Karate King is required.

bonus.name: Ice Hall
bonus.text: Ice crew +10%; a hidden route between Blackthorn and Mahogany.

holdings.catch: A slippery maze; one crew member slides away each crossing.

bonus.name: Tollway
bonus.text: ₽500 from every League challenger; a free ledge shortcut.

holdings.catch: The League's own route; guards and Veteran trainers patrol it.

bonus.name: Lecture Hall
bonus.text: every crew member gains +10% XP from battles; Rock crew take −15% damage.

holdings.catch: Roxanne is an adult teacher. Convert works best (she joins as the crew's Instructor); Break is a long fight in a classroom maze.

bonus.name: Surf Dojo
bonus.text: Fighting crew train ×2; tide pools give 1 free Potion a night.

holdings.catch: Brawly is a surfer and adult; his Gym floods at high tide, so Raids only work at low tide (every other day).

bonus.name: Wattson's Lab
bonus.text: a free Electric item each week (TM or Magnet); Electric crew +1 Speed stage.

holdings.catch: Wattson is a cheerful old man; Buy is cheap but he jokes you into a Debate you must win.

bonus.name: Hot Spring
bonus.text: crew heal 20% each night and ailments clear in one night; Fire crew +10% damage.

holdings.catch: Flannery is a young leader: Beat only if flagged `minor`; adult staff can run the Spa.

bonus.name: Family Gym
bonus.text: Normal crew +10% HP; Loyalty +2 each week to everyone (Norman's "family" talk).

holdings.catch: Norman is a stern adult; Buy needs ₽ and a Regard above 30, never Break.

bonus.name: Treetop Nest
bonus.text: Flying crew +1 Speed stage; a rooftop spotter sees raids 1 day early.

holdings.catch: Winona's Gym is a treehouse; a Break Raid crosses rope bridges and one crew member falls (−HP).

bonus.name: Twin Minds
bonus.text: Psychic crew +10% crit; two crew can share one action.

holdings.catch: Tate & Liza are two Leaders: you must take both (Buy both, or Beat both in one battle).

bonus.name: Water Court
bonus.text: Water crew +10% damage; once a week turn rain on in one district.

holdings.catch: Wallace is a Gym Leader and later Champion; he refuses until you hold Weather Institute or Sootopolis City.

bonus.name: Hoenn Hall of Fame
bonus.text: an Elite Four seat for your own crew; one free Champion-grade practice battle weekly; Steven's cave reward unlocks.

holdings.catch: Needs 8 Gyms. Four Elite Four members fought in a row, then Steven.

bonus.name: Quiet Start
bonus.text: the first crew member recruited each week arrives with a held item.

holdings.catch: Tiny; needs Birch's Lab and the two family houses.

bonus.name: Rest Stop
bonus.text: your crew rests free; Potion Mart −10%.

holdings.catch: Tiny; Poké Mart owner never forced.

bonus.name: Gym Town
bonus.text: Norman's seat; trainers-in-training recruits +1 a week (adults only); Pokémon Center free heal.

holdings.catch: You must hold the Gym first, and Wally's family keeps the town fond of the Gym Leader.

bonus.name: Devon Capital
bonus.text: Devon Corp's HQ; building costs −10%.

holdings.catch: Devon Corp is the big prize; Mr. Stone protects it.

bonus.name: Fishing Town
bonus.text: fish hauls +25%; a hidden cave route.

holdings.catch: Tiny; Granite Cave and Brawly's Gym both help.

bonus.name: Port + Market
bonus.text: import/export lines +2; ships +1.

holdings.catch: Slateport Market and Museum both belong to the city.

bonus.name: Game City
bonus.text: the Game Corner's casino; Bike Shop gives free bikes (−1 travel day).

holdings.catch: Wattson's Gym, Game Corner and Bike Shop.

bonus.name: Contest Town
bonus.text: a Contest stage; Regard +5 each week.

holdings.catch: Tiny; Rydel's Cycles shop owner.

bonus.name: Spa Town
bonus.text: crew heal and gain Loyalty +1 each night.

holdings.catch: The hot springs are Flannery's.

bonus.name: Meteorite Town
bonus.text: Meteorite shards for Dragon training.

holdings.catch: Prof. Cozmo; Aqua and Magma both want it.

bonus.name: Treehouse City
bonus.text: rooftop HQ rooms cost −20%; Winona's sky view reveals raids 1 day early.

holdings.catch: Needs Winona's Gym; invisible Kecleon blocks the bridge until you have the Devon Scope.

bonus.name: Department Store Port
bonus.text: the department store, a museum and the Contest Hall; shop income ×1.5.

holdings.catch: Needs the Dept Store and Aqua/Magma hideouts.

bonus.name: Space City
bonus.text: the Space Center and the Gym; Psychic crew +5%; telescopes give Intel +1.

holdings.catch: Both the Space Center and the Gym must be held; Steven's Letter must be delivered.

bonus.name: Crater City
bonus.text: a sheltered base, police can't patrol.

holdings.catch: Wallace and the Cave of Origin.

bonus.name: Floating Town
bonus.text: the sea routes pay +₽150/day; free Dive access.

holdings.catch: Tiny; the floating logs only hold a small crew at once.

bonus.name: Victory City
bonus.text: League tourism; ₽500/day toll.

holdings.catch: The League and Pokémon Center.

bonus.name: Field Lab
bonus.text: every Pokémon caught is logged and all species' habitats shown; new recruits start with a free starter-line Pokémon; the Hero's starter choice is known.

holdings.catch: Prof. Birch is a beloved adult; Heat +30 if forced. Infiltrate preferred.

bonus.name: Home Rest
bonus.text: crew recover fully and Loyalty +2 each week (one per house, stackable).

holdings.catch: Homes of the Hero and rival's family; robbing them gives Regard −20.

bonus.name: Briney's Boat
bonus.text: the Peeko ferry connects Dewford, Slateport and Route 108 for you; +1 Sea ship; safe passage from Aqua patrols.

stages.name: Foothold

stages.name: The Crown

stages.scene: The Mask face: the team needs a public figurehead. A Roster person, adult, chosen to be crowned. They're told they'll rule. They won't. The Card says so

endings.name: The Puppet King
endings.needs: The Crown, as the Mask
endings.scene: The crowned Roster person is on the throne. The Boss stands behind it. A year on, the King's started making decisions of their own

endings.name: The Mask Falls
endings.needs: Mask 0 and the Reckoning lost
endings.scene: Caught. The Sages testify. Every word they say is one the Boss taught them

endings.name: The Cause Was Real

endings.name: The Primal

endings.scene: Groudon or Kyogre wakes. Off screen: the sky goes red or black. Rayquaza and the Hero calm it. The team watches from the base. Nobody's hurt. Nobody forgets

goals.reason: You took down the memorial. My gran's name's on it.

stages.name: Anouk

endings.name: Ascended
endings.needs: Union accepted, and the Reckoning won
endings.scene: The Boss, joined, stands in the Altar with the wormhole open. They go through. A year on: the Menagerie's empty; Anouk's shelter has a new wing, for Pokémon that were frozen and woke up scared

endings.name: The Fall
endings.needs: Union accepted, and the Hero wins
endings.scene: The Beast lets go. The Boss on the floor. Anouk, if she's come, kneels by them. It's the Goal's most common ending, and its most hopeful

endings.name: Homesick
endings.needs: Every Beast in the Menagerie sent home through the Altar
endings.scene: The Boss opens the wormhole one last time and watches them go. They don't follow. "I thought they were the answer. They were just from somewhere else. Like everyone"

endings.name: The Glass
endings.needs: Twelve or more in the Menagerie at the last room
endings.scene: The Hero walks through the Menagerie to the last room. They wake every one on the way. The Boss can watch or not

goals.reason: You froze them. They were somebody's.

cost.text: As Ascension rises, the Boss looks down on this world's Pokémon, and they know it.

stages.name: Two

stages.scene: "I could hear you through the wall last night. Not your voice. You"

endings.name: The Few
endings.needs: The Great Bloom, and fewer than one in five said yes
endings.scene: The Boss learns the number. That's the scene: a number. "I thought they'd want it. I thought everyone would want it if they knew"

stages.scene: The Boss's oldest friend, in the first district. The Boss stands at the back

stages.name: The First Relic
stages.title: The Ash.
stages.scene: The Boss's six restored. The district's flowers close

stages.name: The Mirror
stages.title: The Boss looks in a mirror at Night.
stages.scene: They look the same as on the first day. Three choices; none of them is relief

stages.name: The Friend Grows Old
stages.title: The Boss's partner Pokémon, their starter, is old.
stages.scene: It sleeps more. It doesn't battle as long. The Boss can't give it years. None of the Relics work on Pokémon

stages.name: The Wish
stages.title: The Scheme
stages.scene: The Scheme

endings.name: Forever
endings.needs: The first wish
endings.scene: A hundred years on. The Boss, unchanged, in a café, reading a history of the region. They're in it, as a footnote

endings.name: Together
endings.needs: The second wish
endings.scene: Everyone, at the last room, always. It's a gift and the Roster's not sure it is one

endings.name: The Ordinary Year
endings.needs: The third wish
endings.scene: The Boss spends the last region doing ordinary things. The epilogue's a garden, and the starter in it, very old, in the sun

endings.name: The Tree
endings.needs: Every Withered district restored, by the Boss's own Works, and no wish made
endings.scene: Xerneas wakes and gives the Withered back their spring. It looks at the Boss and gives them nothing. The Boss says it's fair

goals.reason: The park's gone grey. Gran says it's never been grey.

cost.name: Withering
cost.text: A town that gives up life for the Boss's years goes grey.

opposition.name: Time
opposition.line: Nothing the Boss does stops the clock for anyone else.

stages.name: The First Window
stages.title: A café's coffee machine.
stages.scene: The Boss hears the café owner sing when nobody's in

stages.name: The Wall of Screens
stages.title: A room at the base with every Window on it.
stages.scene: The Roster won't go in

stages.name: The Fond One
stages.title: The first Rotom stops reporting.
stages.scene: The Boss can see what it's hiding, and chooses whether to look

stages.name: The Static
stages.title: The Rotom organise
stages.scene: The Rotom organise

stages.name: Every Window
stages.title: The Scheme: a Rotom in every pocket. Means: Sight 80. Place: the Company (a phone factory). Key: a Rotom that's willing to lead. Moment: the phone's launch day
stages.scene: The Scheme: a Rotom in every pocket. Means: Sight 80. Place: the Company (a phone factory). Key: a Rotom that's willing to lead. Moment: the phone's launch day

endings.name: All-Seeing
endings.needs: The Scheme, with the Static purged
endings.scene: Every Window lit. The Boss sees everything. A year on, they've stopped watching most of it. There's too much

endings.name: The Open Window
endings.needs: The Scheme, and the Boss puts the team's own base on every screen too
endings.scene: Everyone can see everyone, the team included. The Ledger's live. It's not better. It's fair

endings.name: The Static's Terms
endings.needs: The Static negotiated with
endings.scene: The Rotom run a network of their own, for whoever asks. The Boss is a customer

endings.name: Unplugged
endings.needs: Brannock's taken out every Window in a region
endings.scene: The Boss's wall of screens, dark. Brannock at the base's gate with a toolbag. "Got a fridge needs looking at?"

cost.name: Trust
cost.text: People stop trusting their own homes.

opposition.name: The Repairman
opposition.line: Mr. Cosimo Brannock knows what a Rotom sounds like when it's somewhere it shouldn't be.

stages.name: The Claim
stages.title: The Boss reads the family tree to the Roster.
stages.scene: Someone asks if they get a title

stages.name: The First Fealty
stages.title: A farmer kneels.
stages.scene: It's awkward. He's got a bad knee

stages.name: The Pretender
stages.title: Someone else stands up in the square with a crown of their own
stages.scene: Someone else stands up in the square with a crown of their own

stages.name: AZ
stages.title: The meeting
stages.scene: The meeting

stages.name: The Coronation
stages.title: The Scheme. Means: Legitimacy 80. Place: the region's ancient throne (Galar's Hammerlocke vault; Kalos's ruins; a castle elsewhere). Key: the Crown. Moment: the region's oldest festival
stages.scene: The Scheme. Means: Legitimacy 80. Place: the region's ancient throne (Galar's Hammerlocke vault; Kalos's ruins; a castle elsewhere). Key: the Crown. Moment: the region's oldest festival

endings.name: Crowned
endings.needs: The Coronation
endings.scene: The crown fits. A year on: a royal budget, a royal grievance, a royal leak in the roof

endings.name: The Pretender Exposed
endings.needs: The Truth is False, and found out in public
endings.scene: The Boss is a pretender too. They're laughed off the throne. Or they say so first, and are cheered for it

endings.name: The Commonwealth
endings.needs: Crowned, then the Boss abdicates to a council of the fiefs
endings.scene: The crown's in a museum. The Boss's name's on the plaque as the last king. It's the Goal's best ending, and AZ is at the opening

endings.name: Everyone's Crown
endings.needs: The Truth is Everyone, and the Boss announces it
endings.scene: Half the region's royal. The baker has a tiara. Nobody's quite sure how to govern after that, and it's lovely

cost.name: Pretenders
cost.text: Every Legitimacy point the team gains, someone else claims the throne too.

opposition.name: The Pretenders
opposition.line: Someone else stands up in the square with a crown of their own.

goals.name: Apex

stages.name: The Ladder
stages.title: The first rival beaten fair.
stages.scene: They ask for a rematch. The Boss says yes, or doesn't

stages.name: The Gym
stages.title: A Leader asks the Boss to teach.
stages.scene: It's a Bend, backwards (Part 8)

stages.name: The Specimen Asks
stages.title: The question:
stages.scene: "What's it for?" Three answers: "To win." · "To protect the team." · "I don't know." The answer's kept and shapes the last battle

stages.name: The Elite
stages.title: The Champion writes.
stages.scene: "I've heard. Come when you're ready. Not before"

stages.name: The Champion
stages.title: Means: Rank 2. Place: the League. Key: the Apex Specimen at 100. Moment: the Champion's own day
stages.scene: Means: Rank 2. Place: the League. Key: the Apex Specimen at 100. Moment: the Champion's own day

endings.name: The Apex
endings.needs: The Champion beaten
endings.scene: The Boss is the strongest in the region. The next morning, a child challenges them at the gate. The Boss accepts

endings.name: Second
endings.needs: The Rival beats the Boss at a Cup and the Boss asks for no rematch
endings.scene: The Boss is second. The epilogue's the Boss watching the Rival's Champion match, from the stands, cheering. It's the Goal's gentlest ending

endings.name: The Teacher
endings.needs: The Specimen's answer was "To protect the team," and the Boss runs a Gym by the end
endings.scene: The team's a Gym. Its trainers are fair, and frightening

endings.name: Burnt Out
endings.needs: Burnout 10 at the last room
endings.scene: The Apex Specimen sits down in the last room and won't get up. The Hero sits down next to it. The Boss, eventually, does too

goals.reason: You beat everyone. What happens when there's nobody left?

cost.name: Burnout
cost.text: The team's Pokémon, worn down by Harsh training and too many battles a day.

opposition.name: The Champion
opposition.line: "I've heard. Come when you're ready. Not before."

goals.name: Clean Slate

stages.name: The Wound
stages.title: Remembering
stages.scene: Each town keeps it: a memorial, a song the school sings, an old man at the pub.

stages.name: The Keepers
stages.title: Mrs. Winslow
stages.scene: She was a child when the Wound happened and has told it every year since.

stages.name: The Lake Trio
stages.title: Uxie asks
stages.scene: "What will they not know?" A lie, and Uxie never helps again.

stages.name: The Name
stages.title: The twist
stages.scene: The name in Winslow's story is the Boss's, or their mother's. It's been the Boss's memory all along.

stages.name: The Slate
stages.title: The Scheme
stages.scene: The three lakes, in one night, on the Wound's anniversary.

endings.name: The Forgetting
endings.needs: The Slate, and Azelf answered "No" (the Boss keeps the memory)
endings.scene: The region forgets. The Boss is the only one who remembers. A year on, the Boss keeps a memorial in the Office. It's the only one left

endings.name: The Clean Slate
endings.needs: The Slate, and Azelf answered "Yes"
endings.scene: Everyone forgets, the Boss included. The epilogue's the Boss in a café, puzzled by a song a child's humming. They don't know why they cry

endings.name: The Repetition
endings.needs: Repetition 10
endings.scene: It happens again, off screen. The team's there. The Hero's there. This time someone does something about it; and everyone remembers that

endings.name: The Remembering
endings.needs: Listened to every Keeper; never Erased
endings.scene: The Boss tells the story. In the square, on the anniversary. Mesprit's at the edge of the crowd. It doesn't take anything away. It makes it bearable

goals.reason: Gran can't remember Grandad. She could last week.

opposition.name: The Keepers
opposition.line: Mrs. Ignatia Winslow, 83, has told it every year since.

study-the-elite-four.note: Studied Elite Four members fight 2 levels lower; learning their send-out order and their tell (+15% first move) needs a battle-side preview the battle screen doesn't have (listed in docs/status/dominion-d17.md).

elite-bribe.note: Each bribe sways the Champion's circle (Shadow's "Champion compromised" at 3 sway); the aide's vote at Lv 5 isn't acted on.

elite-debate.note: A won debate sways the Elite: they field one Pokémon fewer.

elite-rumour.note: The rumour sways one Elite: they field one Pokémon fewer. Stepping down at Lv 5 isn't acted on.

elite-gift.note: A gift sways one Elite: they field one Pokémon fewer.

champion-letter.note: Each letter is one sway toward "Champion compromised"; the pact of non-interference at Lv 5 isn't acted on.

pre-league-spar.note: A hopeful joining at Lv 4 isn't acted on.

gate-guard-bribe.note: The pass is one sway toward "Champion compromised"; passes by length aren't tracked.

elite-s-weak-spot.note: Leverage is one sway toward "Champion compromised".

final-stand-prep.note: Each plan is one Plan point (max 5): every point is one Pokémon fewer on the Hero's side at the final stand, down to 4.

takeover-speech.note: Also one Plan point toward the path you are closest to.

wipe-out-plan.note: The plan weakens the rival team (power −2).

goal-plan.note: Your Goal Track +3 (a Rule team has no Goal: no effect beyond XP).

pirate-radio.note: The hijack plays the broadcast for the town; the clip naming a rival and the speech at higher levels read the same.

meet-the-champion.note: Opens once the Elite Four are beaten (the Champion stage); each meeting is one sway toward "Champion compromised". The stand-down offer at Lv 5 isn't acted on.
